# Jori

> Jori is a shared workspace for AI jobs, tables, and files. Teams describe recurring work in plain language, choose when it runs, and organize access and spend by folder.

This is the official site for Jori at usejori.com. The public pages below describe the product, availability, pricing, and access controls. Their text is readable without JavaScript; interactive demos use example data.

## Product

- [Jori overview](https://usejori.com/): How jobs, folders, tables, files, and integrations work together, with interactive examples and a waitlist.
- [Pricing and availability](https://usejori.com/pricing): Current access, the organization-wide pricing model, usage billing, and trial details. Example balances are illustrative; consult this page for published pricing.
- [Trust and data regions](https://usejori.com/trust): Job permissions, action approvals, run receipts, and EU or US workspace storage, including services that may process data outside the selected region.

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://usejori.com/privacy): How personal data is handled.
- [Terms of service](https://usejori.com/terms): Terms for using Jori.
- [Data processing agreement](https://usejori.com/dpa): Data processing terms and subprocessors.
